Job Description: About Broadcom VMware by Broadcom is a leader in datacenter infrastructure, networking, security, and virtualization software. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer to join the Application Networking and Security (ANS) division. About the ANS Team ANS is a fast-paced, tight-knit team providing advanced security solutions such as Distributed Firewall and Rule Recommendation, Network Traffic Anomalies Detection, Network Flows Visualization and Monitoring, Intrusion Detection and Prevention and Malware Prevention. About the Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to streamline our software development lifecycle, automate infrastructure workflows, and enhance deployment reliability. You will bridge the gap between development and operations by managing version control, maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines, and leveraging modern scripting and AI-driven automation tools. Key Responsibilities • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, build, and maintain automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins to ensure fast, reliable code delivery. • Version Control & Build Systems: Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, and merge workflows using Git, while optimizing build systems for speed and consistency. • System Administration: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux-based servers and environments to ensure high availability, performance, and security. • Automation & Scripting: Write clean, maintainable scripts in Python to automate repetitive operational tasks, system checks, and deployment workflows. • AI-Assisted Operations: Integrate modern AI tools (such as AI coding assistants, automated code-review bots, or AIOps monitoring tools) into daily workflows to accelerate troubleshooting, script generation, and anomaly detection. • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner closely with software developers, QA engineers, and security teams to resolve build failures, manage releases, and enforce DevOps best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in software product. • Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science. • Version Control: Strong hands-on experience with Git (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket), including branching models, pull requests, and conflict resolution. • CI/CD & Build Tools: Proven experience setting up and administering Jenkins (declarative/scripted pipelines, plugins, webhooks) and familiarity with build tools (e.g., Maven, Gradle, npm, or Make). • Operating Systems: Solid command-line proficiency in Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL), including process management, networking basics, permissions, and shell scripting. • Programming/Scripting: Practical experience writing automation scripts and utilities using Python. • AI Tooling: Familiarity with using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/LLMs, or AI-powered log analysis/observability tools) to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency. • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose pipeline bottlenecks, build errors, and environment issues quickly. Nice-to-Have Qualifications • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes). • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform). title: Senior Java Developer
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll join a global community of experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely to shape the future of Java modernization. In this position, you will design, build, and maintain high-volume business logic while refactoring legacy code to enable seamless integration with modern cloud and mobile applications. Beyond technical execution, you will bring strong leadership skills to guide and mentor an offshore engineering team over the long term. Key Responsibilities Microservices Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable microservices using Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4. Event Streaming & Kafka: Implement real-time event streaming solutions using Apache Kafka to consume, transform, enrich, and publish streaming data. Data Integration & Persistence: Implement change-detection logic, publish event updates, and optimize data persistence within MySQL databases. Cloud & Resiliency Architecture: Deploy and manage applications on Microsoft Azure PaaS, ensuring fault-tolerant, scalable, and highly available streaming architectures. Reliability & Testing: Configure robust retry mechanisms, dead-letter topics, and idempotent processing while writing comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests. DevOps & Delivery: Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Team Leadership: Mentor and guide an offshore development team to foster technical growth and ensure delivery excellence. Database Management: Proficiency in MySQL database integration, query optimization, and implementing change-data capture/detection patterns. Distributed Systems Reliability: Demonstrated ability to build resilient systems utilizing idempotent processing, fault-tolerant design, retry handling, and dead-letter queues. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience Required 10 years+ Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred Qualifications Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. description: Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. KDT unit within KTI is responsible for developing Digital Services products such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Residential Flow and Partnership Ecosystem Role purpose We are seeking a Lead Architect to define and govern the end-to-end architecture of our global industrial IoT and digital platform ecosystem . The role connects physical equipment, gateway runtimes, device connectivity, cloud platforms, digital applications, enterprise identity, and AI-enabled capabilities into a coherent, evolvable architecture. The architect will establish architecture-first delivery practices in which business capabilities, quality attributes, system boundaries, contracts, security requirements, and operational models are defined before implementation. You will translate complex technical decisions into clear recommendations for engineering and business stakeholders, connecting choices to customer value, cost, risk, reliability, delivery timelines, and operational readiness. What you will do Own target architectures, system boundaries, contracts, quality requirements, and technical roadmaps. Document alternatives, assumptions, failure modes, and trade-offs before implementation. Design multi-region routing, tenant and workload isolation, data placement, replication, failover and failback. Define RTO, RPO, availability objectives, and recovery validation for each workload. Enable repeatable regional expansion through reusable infrastructure, automated onboarding, configuration-driven deployment, and application designs that avoid regional forks. Govern industrial edge connectivity, device provisioning, certificate lifecycle, offline behavior, secure OTA updates, and command handling with embedded and safety specialists. Architect cloud services, APIs, real-time integrations, messaging, and data platforms with explicit ownership, compatibility, tenant isolation, and failure behavior. Embed security, observability, capacity planning, cost management, upgrade paths, and operational readiness into every architecture. Establish practical architecture standards, ADRs, reusable platform capabilities, repository boundaries, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery checks. Communicate through clear diagrams, business-focused narratives, and decision options. Lead cross-team reviews, mentor engineers, and build trust with stakeholders. Evaluate AI-assisted engineering and AI-enabled applications with specialist teams, considering business value, privacy, permissions, security, limitations, evaluation, and human oversight. PKI, device identity, and cryptographic architecture Architecture focus: PKI is a foundational device trust system, not merely a subtopic within general identity and security. The role must govern identity from factory provisioning through operational use, renewal, revocation, retirement, and long-lived hardware replacement. Define hardware-backed device identity using IEEE 802.1AR concepts, including factory identity and operational identity, with TPM 2.0 or secure-element roots of trust. Design zero-touch enrollment and renewal using appropriate protocols such as EST, SCEP, or CMPv2, with explicit bootstrap, recovery, renewal, revocation, and offline behavior. Author X.509 certificate profiles aligned with RFC 5280, including subject naming, SAN conventions, EKU constraints, key usage, validity periods, policy OIDs, CRL distribution points, and validation rules. Design CA hierarchies, trust domains, signing boundaries, key ceremonies, offline root protection, intermediate CA operations, HSM integration, and delegated issuance. Govern certificate rotation at fleet scale, including clock drift, intermittent connectivity, dual-certificate overlap, compromised-device recovery, factory reset, ownership transfer, and end-of-life handling. Define cryptographic agility and long-term migration strategies for algorithm changes, including assessment of post-quantum standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA where appropriate. Standards, RFCs, and normative specifications Establish a reference architecture and standards catalogue that distinguishes mandatory requirements from recommendations. Use RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 terminology consistently when writing normative specifications. Use MUST and MUST NOT for binding requirements; use SHOULD and SHOULD NOT for strong recommendations with documented exceptions; use MAY for permitted options. Maintain versioned specifications for identity, certificate profiles, TLS, MQTT topics, API contracts, event schemas, command semantics, error handling, and regional deployment. Reference applicable standards such as RFC 5280 for X.509 certificates, RFC 7030 for EST, RFC 8446 for TLS 1.3, RFC 6455 for WebSockets, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications, OpenAPI, and the OASIS MQTT specification. Use ADRs to record context, decision, alternatives, consequences, security impact, operational impact, and conditions for revisiting the decision. Keep C4, deployment, sequence, threat, and data-flow models versioned with the systems they describe. Required experience 14+ years in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or systems architecture, including 6+ years leading architecture for complex enterprise, industrial, or mission-critical systems. Proven production delivery and operational experience with multi-region systems, disaster recovery, incident response, and recovery validation. Strong system design judgment and hands-on ability to validate decisions through prototypes, code reviews, performance testing, load testing, and operational evidence. Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. Experience creating standards and governance that enable delivery rather than introducing unnecessary process. Preferred experience Industrial equipment, fleet management, OT cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, digital twins, or large-scale multi-tenant platforms. Platform engineering, technology modernization, and practical exposure to AI-assisted development or enterprise AI integration. Experience with long-lived devices, constrained connectivity, safety-related command paths, and supplier or partner integration. Certifications Certifications are desirable but not mandatory. They do not replace demonstrated system design expertise and production experience. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Security – Specialty. Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture qualification. Relevant Microsoft identity, security, industrial cybersecurity, or cryptography certifications. Multi-region applications meet agreed availability, RTO, and RPO objectives, with recovery regularly tested. Device identity and PKI operations are automated, observable, recoverable, and secure throughout the asset lifecycle. Platforms remain secure, operable, and maintainable as devices, tenants, integrations, and capabilities grow. Normative standards and reusable platform capabilities reduce duplication, incompatible changes, and operational toil.
